snippet.title: The Last Winter Knight - Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768420/The_Last_Winter_Knight/

Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.
